messages:
Samir Patel: Heads up — Kitewell POC kickoff Thurs 10am PT (SRE + AI engineers). Dropping a quick intake + draft agenda here. Need alignment on success criteria, dataset access, security asks, and pricing posture.
Maya Chen: I can own the success criteria + eval harness. Can we get a sample dataset by Wed EOD?
Jordan Lee: I will draft the prompt set. Request: 200 prompts across 4 intents, plus regen/robustness tests.
Elena Ruiz: Customer asks about dedicated capacity pricing and pilot discounts. Also wants to see an SLA for latency.
Samir Patel: Actionable asks for the kickoff: 1) confirm dataset format (schema), 2) QPS & avg sequence length, 3) who's the security contact to send questionnaire to, 4) desired business metric improvement targets.
Maya Chen: For success criteria I'm proposing: - Intent recall >= 90% (slot extraction F1 >= 0.86) - Escalation reduction >= 25% - p95 latency < 350ms for typical 512-token context on hosted plan
Jordan Lee: Note on latency: we should measure p95 both cold and warm KV cache. Also add model quality guardrail: hallucination rate < 2% on validation prompts.
Elena Ruiz: Customer KPI: reduce manual tagging time 50% and cut monthly moderation costs by 30% — worth calling out in the kickoff. On pricing: they're okay with a 1-month paid pilot if we can guarantee performance.
Samir Patel: Good. Pricing approach for pilot: offer hosted trial w/ pilot discount (15-25% depending on commit) OR 4-week Dedicated eval (short-term reserved GPUs) if they need lower variance SLA. I can share numbers after we get QPS.
Jordan Lee: Discovery questions to ask at kickoff: - sample traffic profile (qps spikes, avg/95 pct) - sample prompt/response pairs - PII presence & redaction needs - compliance: SOC2, GDPR, data residency - SSO/SAML requirements
Maya Chen: Eval harness quick run (example):
```
python eval_harness.py --prompts kitewell_prompts.json --model redwood/opt-13b --metrics intent,f1,latency --out results.json
```
Samir Patel: Pre-kickoff checklist: 1) NDA signed (legal) 2) Security questionnaire owner identified 3) sample data uploaded to our secure S3 bucket or shared via encrypted link 4) pilot scope doc (stakeholders, success metrics, timeline)
Elena Ruiz: Stakeholders attending kickoff: Kitewell - Head of ML (Priya), Platform Eng (Marco), Security (Olga). Our side: Samir, Maya, Jordan, solutions engineer (TBD).
Jordan Lee: Timeline proposal: Week0 = kickoff + data intake; Week1 = eval runs + tuning; Week2 = joint demo + metrics review; End Week3 = decision/rollout plan.
Samir Patel: I'll send the calendar invite after Elena confirms attendee list. Also tagging deploy-bot to reserve a Dedicated GPU slot for smoke tests (if we choose that track). :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reserved 1x A100-80GB for 2 hours on 2025-03-12 18:00 UTC for smoke tests.
Maya Chen: I'll prepare the prompt set and baseline eval by Wed. Jordan — can you put together the regen robustness checks?
Jordan Lee: Yep. I'll also add synthetic edge cases (typos, truncated context, adversarial intents).
Samir Patel: Perfect. Final action items: Samir — confirm pricing draft after QPS; Maya — eval harness + prompts; Jordan — robustness suite; Elena — confirm customer attendees & security contact. See you all on Thurs. :rocket:
